name: resident_patch_script_semantics
purpose: Define resident-mode patch-script semantics for active TL-UL repeated/depth candidate gates.

accepted_semantics.state_residency: The full state array remains device-resident across resident eval steps.
accepted_semantics.initial_state_upload: The optional init-state upload is performed once before the resident loop begins.
accepted_semantics.patch_schedule_upload: Per-step patch changes are uploaded once as a compact schedule before the resident loop begins.
accepted_semantics.per_step_host_copy: No cuMemcpyHtoD patch copy may occur inside the resident step loop.
accepted_semantics.final_state_download: Final DtoH occurs only when --dump-state is requested.

patch_schedule_abi.host_input_text_format: Reuse the existing --patch-script text grammar as the source format.
patch_schedule_abi.empty_step_encoding: A step with '-' has zero records and still advances one resident eval step.
patch_schedule_abi.repeat_encoding: @repeat-seq blocks are expanded or indexed before resident execution.
patch_schedule_abi.offset_scope: global_byte_offset is relative to the full device storage buffer.
